name: EKODI v8 Command Plane
purpose: Coordinate provider-diverse AI specialists under EKODI-owned identity, policy, authorization, audit and verification authority without coupling work to user-facing hostnames.

roles.commander: goal decomposition, assignment and bounded coordination
roles.sentinel: independent evidence review and completion challenge
roles.core: identity, policy, authorization, resource truth and audit

resourceAddressing.routeResolutionOwnedBy: EKODI routing governance and runtime adapters

relationshipToUrlMigration.canonicalIntent: my and admin user surfaces may migrate to ekodi.kr path namespaces without changing Command Plane identity or authority semantics
relationshipToUrlMigration.rule: Command Plane targets resources symbolically and leaves canonical URL resolution to routing governance, so URL migration and AI orchestration may proceed in parallel.
